headline: Lowe's comps edged up 0.2% as Pro and online offset weak DIY; FY2026 outlook cut to flat comps and low end of EPS range.
guidance_note: FY2026 sales ~$92.0bn (was $92-94bn), comps ~flat (was flat to +2%), adj EPS ~$12.25 (was $12.25-12.75); includes tariff refund benefits.
key_messages: Comps +0.2% (5th straight positive): ticket +2.3% on modest inflation and Pro, transactions -2.1%.
Pro, online (+15.7%) and Home Services carried the quarter; discretionary DIY spending remained under pressure.
Monthly comps weakened through the quarter (July -1.2%), prompting a cut to flat full-year comps.
Gross margin fell 77bps; Lowe's declined to match competitors using tariff-refund dollars to cut seasonal prices.
Sales +8.3% to $26.0bn, boosted by FBM and ADG acquisitions; adj EPS $4.40 beat ~$4.22.

consumer.big_ticket: Cautious homeowners are holding back on discretionary DIY projects; growth came from Pro, home services and smaller repair categories (rough plumbing, electrical).
consumer.pricing: Modest price inflation lifted ticket; competitors used tariff refunds to price seasonal aggressively, which Lowe's chose not to match.

macro_read: DIY homeowners are pulling back as the year progresses, with demand concentrated in Pro and must-do repairs; promotional pricing signals softer consumer demand in the category.

sources.label: Chain Store Age: Pro, online sales drive Lowe's Q2
Trefis: Shrinking store sales and Lowe's stock
